```
Usage: taiga-cli create-task [OPTIONS]

Options:
  --subject TEXT      Task subject (single task)
  --description TEXT  Task description (single task)

  --tasks-json TEXT   JSON array of tasks: '[{"subject": "...", "description":
                      "..."}]'
```
